_comment: Each mall is a seed for the crawler, not a guarantee of coverage -- sites differ in whether they expose offers to a crawler at all (see 'render' and 'coverage_note'). URLs were verified reachable by web search/fetch on 2026-10-12. The crawler also tries each mall's sitemap for newer offer/event pages instead of relying only on the hardcoded 'pages' below, so a single stale hardcoded slug can no longer be the sole source of an offer.

malls.name: Mall of Qatar
malls.coverage_note: mallofqatar.com.qa is a JavaScript single-page app -- confirmed by fetching it directly, its initial HTML is just a loading shell. The crawler renders it with a headless browser (see fetch_engine.py) instead of silently returning nothing. If Playwright/Chromium isn't installed in the run environment, this source yields zero offers rather than stale or invented ones.

malls.name: Doha Festival City
malls.coverage_note: The offers page shell is server-rendered but the offer cards themselves load via an in-page AJAX call after JS runs, so this also needs the headless-browser render to see real offers.

malls.name: Place Vendôme Qatar
malls.coverage_note: Added this run as a newly verified source (official site confirmed via search); its offers page structure has not been crawled before, so its first run should be treated as unverified until it has produced and held a real offer with a working source link.
